name: UNAUTHENTICATED_REQUEST
user_message: You are not signed in. Sign in to your account and try again.
notes: Thrown when any Customer or Bank operations action is attempted without a valid authenticated session (FR-011).

name: INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS
user_message: The sign-in details you entered are not correct. Please check them and try again.
notes: Thrown during login (FR-003) when the supplied identity cannot be authenticated.

name: LOGOUT_FAILED
user_message: We could not end your session. Please try signing out again.
notes: Thrown when a logout attempt (FR-004) cannot terminate the active session.

name: ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE
user_message: This account is not active and cannot be used right now. Please contact Bank operations for help.
notes: Thrown when an account that is not in ACTIVE state is used for a transaction or statement action. Referenced by transaction preconditions.

name: DESTINATION_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
user_message: The account you are sending to could not be found. Check the account details and try again.
notes: Thrown when a transfer (FR-005) names a destination account that does not exist or is not receivable.

name: KYC_DOCUMENT_VALIDATION_FAILED
user_message: One or more of your identity documents could not be accepted. Review your Aadhaar and PAN entries and try again.
notes: Thrown during registration/KYC (FR-001) when Aadhaar or PAN fails format validation.

name: INVALID_AADHAAR_FORMAT
user_message: The Aadhaar number must be exactly 12 digits. Please correct it and try again.
notes: Thrown when the Aadhaar number is not exactly 12 numeric digits (length boundary: 11/12/13).

name: INVALID_PAN_FORMAT
user_message: The PAN must be 10 characters: 5 letters, 4 digits, and 1 letter. Please correct it and try again.
notes: Thrown when the PAN does not match the 5-letter+4-digit+1-letter pattern (length boundary: 9/10/11).

name: STATE_CHANGE_PERSISTENCE_FAILED
user_message: Something went wrong while saving your changes. Please try again, and contact support if the problem continues.
notes: Thrown when an account, KYC, or transaction state change cannot be durably persisted (FR-014, FR-016).

name: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE_BELOW_MINIMUM
user_message: This transfer cannot be completed because it would leave your account below the required minimum balance. Please enter a smaller amount.
notes: Thrown when an outward transfer would drop the account balance below MIN_BALANCE (OQ-002). Boundary: MIN_BALANCE - 0.01 rejected, MIN_BALANCE allowed.

name: DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP_EXCEEDED
user_message: This transfer would exceed your daily transfer limit. Please wait until your limit resets or enter a smaller amount.
notes: Thrown when the day's total plus the new transfer exceeds DAILY_TRANSFER_CAP (OQ-003). Boundary: cap + 0.01 rejected, cap allowed.

name: INVALID_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
user_message: The transfer amount must be a positive amount. Please enter an amount greater than zero.
notes: Thrown when a transfer amount is zero or negative, or has more than 2 decimal places.

name: PERMISSION_DENIED
user_message: You do not have permission to do this. Please contact an administrator if you believe this is a mistake.
notes: Thrown when a role attempts an action outside its permission set, e.g. Bank operations initiating a transfer (FR-010) or accessing data not permitted by role (FR-012).

name: INTERNAL_SYSTEM_ERROR
user_message: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later, and contact support if the problem continues.
notes: Generic fallback error; also used where accessibility/testability acceptance conditions are not met (FR-013, FR-015, FR-017).
